SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem l
INNER JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
INNER JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
INNER JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
INNER JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01'
GROUP BY r.r_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_shipment_count
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01'
  AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
  AND l_shipdate > l_commitdate

SELECT l_shipmode AS ship_mode,
       AVG(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate <= l_commitdate THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS on_time_delivery_rate
FROM lineitem
GROUP BY l_shipmode
ORDER BY l_shipmode

SELECT
  n.n_name AS nation_name,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS profit
FROM lineitem l
INNER JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
INNER JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
INNER JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01'
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY profit DESC

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS lifetime_value FROM customer c INNER JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.c_mktsegment AS market_segment, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN customer AS c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY average_order_value DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_high_priority_orders
FROM orders
WHERE o_orderstatus = 'O'
  AND o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH'

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS inventory_value FROM partsupp ps INNER JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey INNER JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY inventory_value DESC
SELECT l_shipmode AS ship_mode, COUNT(*) AS returned_item_count FROM lineitem WHERE l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY returned_item_count DESC
SELECT l_shipmode AS ship_mode, AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', l_commitdate, l_receiptdate)) AS avg_shipping_days FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY l_shipmode

SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_billed
FROM orders
WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1999-01-01'

SELECT o.o_orderpriority AS priority, AVG(x.line_count) AS avg_basket_size FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) x ON o.o_orderkey = x.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY priority

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spend
